{{Quote|A blind Gungan could see that you've had this court rigged from the start.|[[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] to Natasi Daala, on the Court of Jedi Affairs|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
The '''Court of Jedi Affairs''' was a court formed by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] to deal with legal issues involving the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. It was created mainly to handle the sudden onset of a [[Force psychosis|mysterious psychosis]] in several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], but it also dealt with all other affairs concerning [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. It was headed by the [[Zoolli]] [[Judge/Legends|Judge]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]], who had been handpicked for the job by Daala. After Lorteli signed a writ permitting the Jedi, who were accompanied by [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran]] and [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Horn]], as well as several [[Journalist/Legends|reporters]], to visit [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]], leading to a near-public relations disaster for the Galactic Alliance, Lorteli was dismissed by Daala and the court was put on hold.
